stages.title: Reconnaissance
stages.objective: Use `mhsec scan` to map Meridian's exposed/risky surface.
stages.win_condition: Identify the DMZ patient portal and the legacy CLINICAL host exposing telnet.
stages.question: Name the internet-facing patient portal host and the clinical host still exposing telnet.

stages.title: Entry - social engineering
stages.objective: Use `mhsec phish` to find the breach email; name the tactics; recommend hardening.
stages.win_condition: Flag email M999 from the lookalike domain with urgency+authority+credential-link.
stages.question: Which email ID is the breach email, and which domain sent it?

stages.title: Credential attack
stages.objective: Use `mhsec loganalyze` to detect the password-spray campaign against Meridian's VPN.
stages.win_condition: Identify src_ip 198.51.100.77 with >=5 distinct users and >=20 failed logins.
stages.question: Which source IP is running the password spray?

stages.title: Network pivot
stages.objective: Use `mhsec pivot` to trace lateral movement from the compromised workstation.
stages.win_condition: Trace ws-nguyen (10.20.5.40) -> fileserver (SMB) -> dc01 (LDAP) in order.
stages.question: List the attacker's path from the compromised workstation, host by host, in order.

stages.title: Device compromise
stages.objective: Use `mhsec iocscan` to find the malicious process planted on the victim's endpoint.
stages.win_condition: Flag upd_svc.exe / hash a1c9f0e7malware on host ws-nguyen.
stages.question: Which process is malicious, and on which host?

stages.title: App/data exfiltration
stages.objective: Use `mhsec exfil` to find the abnormal outbound transfer from the database host.
stages.win_condition: Flag the 250MB transfer from sql01 to external IP 203.0.113.99.
stages.question: Which host sent the data out, and to which external IP?

stages.title: Detection + IR + report
stages.objective: Use `mhsec report` to produce the full after-action report tying every stage together.
stages.win_condition: Report includes the phished victim, the pivot chain, the endpoint IOC, the exfil destination, and a remediation recommendation list.
stages.question: Name the phished employee and the first host to isolate.
